title: Prefill: KDA chain (core + conv + gated o_norm)
shape: DEP16 F16K (3 x 5,456 tok) at L78K, NVFP4, 96 KDA heads at TP1, FP32 state (per GPU, per prefill forward, 69 KDA layers)
basis: PROJECTED (reviewed ledger); model nvfp4_modelopt|P3-16|prefill per layer: conv 55.1 + gate_beta_norm 18.4 + core_prefill 167.0 + o_norm 12.2 = 252.7 us x 69 = 17.4 ms
gap_analysis: Model prices conv and o_norm with zero activation bytes (fused into the core's load / store) and core_prefill as one memory-bound pass (2.0 GB/layer: q,k,v,g in, o out). Today: separate fused-QKV conv pass (reads 1.2 GB, writes 1.2 GB), FlashKDA K1 prepare (reads q,k,g, writes three bf16 [T,H,D] workspaces + tiles), K2 recurrence (reads v + workspaces, writes o), separate gated o_norm + MXFP8 quant pass. 96 heads x 3 seqs exceed the in-tree v-split build's one-wave limit, so the stock full-width K2 runs (288 CTAs over 212 SMs, chunk-serial over 341 16-token chunks). Baseline per-kernel breakdown at the deployed shape is being measured.
inefficiencies: No 96-head v-split recurrence build (stock full-width K2, 288 CTAs > 1 wave) [ledger, re-measuring]
Separate prepare pass K1 with ~1.2 GB workspace round trip [code reading; bytes to be measured]
Unfused conv (2.4 GB HBM pass) and gated o_norm + MXFP8 quant (~1 GB pass) [code reading]
rubin_features: bulk async copies (TMA) for the g / beta / dt_bias tiles, overlapped with the in-load conv
packed FP32 FMA (fma.rn.f32x2) and packed FP32 mul/add in the conv + SiLU (IEEE per lane)
planned: tcgen05 MMA with TMEM-resident accumulators for the 96-head recurrence; larger per-SM shared memory for resident state
plan: Baseline per-kernel microbench of the chain at F16K and F8K on 1 VR200 GPU (queued)
Fuse the Q|K|V short conv into FlashKDA prepare (K1 reads raw rows, writes conv V for K2): removes the 2.4 GB conv pass, adds ~0.8 GB (implemented, test pending)
Fuse gated o_norm + MXFP8 quant into the full-width recurrence epilogue (removes ~0.8 GB o round trip)
Hide prepare (K1) under the compute-bound recurrence: concurrent K1/K2 with per-tile ready flags (workspace stays in L2)
Recurrence throughput: balance 288 (seq, head) items over 212 SMs; tcgen05 recurrence (state FP32 in registers/TMEM, MMAs on the tensor core) if ncu shows the legacy MMA pipe bound
Wire per-shape dispatch in kda.py (stock wiring only), step A/B, landed-ready
